hypothesis: The three prior OpenMP candidates are all valid and have similar aggregate means (0.2379–0.2416 s), but the supplied observations do not establish a clear per-thread comparison. This candidate tests persistent ownership of contiguous z-slabs across six steps, with five explicit dependency barriers and no per-step worksharing dispatch. Stable slab ownership may reduce scheduling overhead or improve locality; coarse slabs may limit utilization at small sizes. Controller measurements at one and four threads, including initialization, are needed before drawing a performance conclusion.
